| description = This mummy actually looks more like a dark-boned skeleton. Highly magic resistant, only lures, taps etc. are likely to land on him. Spawns in the crypt (empty casket room at way back) after handing in [[Dark Shroud]] to Ghost of Glohnor.

On P99 he will not run to you automatically, he stays in place until you go down to crypt and engage him.  If you try and pull him out, other ghosts will assist him (again seems different from descriptions of the live era guides).  Best to fight him at his spawn point!
